trello.name: Send final DataBridge renewal request and prepare legal escalation
trello.desc:
Sofia to send one final email today to DataBridge account manager regarding contract renewal. Email must be plain language and state that revised terms are needed by Thursday close of business. Contract lapses August 29th and no response has been received after two prior emails, last on Monday.
Steps:
1. Compose final email today requesting revised renewal terms by Thursday COB.
2. Monitor for reply.
3. If no reply received by Thursday COB, escalate to legal on Friday morning to review termination-for-convenience options. Do not wait for Ravi approval; the no-reply condition triggers escalation.
Acceptance criteria: Final email sent today with Thursday COB deadline clearly stated; escalation to legal initiated Friday morning if no response by deadline.

trello.name: Request security audit cryptography review from Dana
trello.desc:
Sofia to obtain expert review of external security audit report, 60 pages, specifically sections 4 and 6 on cryptography and key management findings.
Steps:
1. Message Dana today with the audit report and request review of sections 4 and 6.
2. Frame request as coming from Ravi.
3. Request assessment be sent to vendor/compliance sync group before next sync in two weeks.
4. If Dana does not have bandwidth, ask nicely first, then escalate to her manager.
Acceptance criteria: Dana notified today with report and two-week deadline; assessment of sections 4 and 6 distributed to group before next sync.

trello.name: Add logo decision to rebrand FAQ
trello.desc:
Tomas to document the March logo decision in the rebrand FAQ to prevent recurring questions.
Steps:
1. Add a line to the rebrand FAQ stating the logo stays as is and only the color palette changes.
2. Include a link to the March meeting notes where the decision was made.
3. Complete this week.
Acceptance criteria: Rebrand FAQ updated with logo decision statement and link to March meeting notes, visible to Marketing and stakeholders.
